card.name: Programming code and variable naming
card.fires_on: Marks inside programming prose about code, such as the colon in a for-each loop, a variable name like context, or the words around variable naming. It is strongest in software-writing passages.

modes.label: Loop and variable syntax
modes.description: The colon or loop variable inside a for-each example in a coding explanation.

modes.label: Object and method calls
modes.description: The object name or method call in inline code text about actors and contexts.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Isolated words in unrelated text with no code link.
